scope: Same-preview native cyclic control input and constructor comparison with Delaunator.
observations: Delaunator matched seven of nine native triangles in each face. Both differences are diagonals through points 3,4,6,7, whose exact rational incircle determinant is zero. The same-run native 3D points and index triples reconstruct all 18 facets of the earlier cyclic STL export as an unordered multiset.
limitations: This is a cyclic reordering of the same geometry, not an independent shape.
No general native tie rule or constraint handling is established.
No product change or GUI/MCP parity acceptance is claimed.
